  • Method Details

    • style

      public DropdownMulti.Builder<T> style(ControlStyle style)
      Phase 18s follow-up — selects the trigger's visual style. See Dropdown.Builder.style(ControlStyle) for full rationale.

    • at

      public DropdownMulti.Builder<T> at(int childX, int childY)
      Panel-local position. Default (0, 0).

    • triggerSize

      public DropdownMulti.Builder<T> triggerSize(int width, int height)
      Required: trigger width × height in pixels. Popover width matches trigger width.

    • items

      public DropdownMulti.Builder<T> items(List<T> items)
      Required: the items to display in the popover. Defensively copied at build time; mutating post-build does not affect the dropdown. Empty list throws at build().

    • label

      public DropdownMulti.Builder<T> label(Function<T, net.minecraft.network.chat.Component> labelFn)
      Required: per-row label function. Used for each item row in the popover (NOT for the trigger — see triggerLabel(Function)).

    • triggerLabel

      public DropdownMulti.Builder<T> triggerLabel(Function<Set<T>, net.minecraft.network.chat.Component> fn)
      Required: trigger summary function. Receives the current selection Set (defensively-copied snapshot) and returns the trigger's displayed text. Consumers decide the summary shape — "{n} selected", comma-joined labels, etc.

    • selection

      public DropdownMulti.Builder<T> selection(Supplier<Set<T>> supplier, Consumer<T> consumer)
      Required: lens pair. Supplier returns the consumer's current selection Set (library reads each frame for trigger label + row highlights); Consumer is invoked with the clicked item and is expected to toggle its set membership.

      Library never mutates the supplied Set. Identity uses T.equals() (matches Set.contains(Object)).

    • maxVisibleItems

      public DropdownMulti.Builder<T> maxVisibleItems(int n)
      Optional: cap visible regular rows. Default 8.

    • itemTooltip

      public DropdownMulti.Builder<T> itemTooltip(Function<T, net.minecraft.network.chat.Component> fn)
      Optional: per-item tooltip — mirrors Dropdown.Builder.itemTooltip(Function).

    • selectAllRow

      public DropdownMulti.Builder<T> selectAllRow(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component label, Runnable action)
      Optional: configure a "Select all" pinned-top action row. The Runnable is invoked when the row is clicked; consumers typically use it to bulk-add to their selection Set (e.g., () -> selected.addAll(ALL_ITEMS)). Library calls the Runnable directly — no consumer-fires-N-times overhead.

      Renders italic, with no checkmark column. Popover stays open after the click (same as regular-row clicks).

    • clearAllRow

      public DropdownMulti.Builder<T> clearAllRow(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component label, Runnable action)
      Optional: configure a "Clear all" pinned-top action row. Same shape as selectAllRow(Component, Runnable) — Runnable does the bulk clear (e.g., selected::clear).

    • disabledWhen

      public DropdownMulti.Builder<T> disabledWhen(BooleanSupplier disabledWhen)
      Optional disabled predicate (Phase 3b — Item 8). When it returns true, the trigger renders disabled and all interaction is ignored — same semantics as Dropdown.Builder.disabledWhen. Per-frame predicate shape. Default: always enabled.

    • build

      public DropdownMulti<T> build()

    • spec

      public ElementSpec spec()
      Layout terminal (Phase 3b — Item 6). Returns an ElementSpec for use in Row / Column.

      Reported dimensions are the TRIGGER footprint (.triggerSize(w, h)), not the popover — same overflow-by- design model as Dropdown.Builder.spec() (popover renders on the overlay pass and claims its own input region), so Row/Column reserves only the trigger footprint.

      The layout helper calls ElementSpec.at(int, int), which re-runs this builder's configuration positioned at the computed coordinates.
